operations.title: The C4 branch-enhanced triple sector is finite Kummer-Artin
operations.body: Entry 1163 (event 918) resolves the generic B4(p)=0 enhancement. The 296 labelled triple incidences occupy five projective y-points; their activation equations are source Gram-minor evaluations (the alternating point gives det G=0). At a smooth branch hit the pullback divisor is product_i(v+c_i w^2), Milnor rank 10, with semisimple monodromy orders 1:2, 2:2, 3:2, 6:4. A rational weighted resolution classifies it as mixed Tate with finite Kummer/Artin inertia, not a new elliptic/higher-genus block or carrier stratum. Deeper singular-Gram/branch-tangency support remains.
